Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/CoolerMasterController/CMMM712Controller) by a separate Python model mirroring SendInitPacket, SetDirectMode and SetLedsDirect (openrgb-work/batch2/coolermaster/gen_mice.py in the porting session's scratch space); plugin.js was never run to make them. Initialize = the constructor's init packet (44 81 02 + read; the 4C 81 07 / 4C 81 08 / 4C 81 03 status round trip is left out) and OpenRGB's switch to Direct (SetDirectMode(true): 5A 81 02); every frame = SetLedsDirect, which sends 5A 81 02 again (OpenRGB's current_mode never becomes Direct) and then 5A 81 03 R G B; shutdown = SetDirectMode(false): 5A 81 01, back to the mouse's own mode. ops as in the other fixtures (65-byte output reports, report id 0x00; reads 250 ms).
